description: Get a specific user by ID
sql: SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.ibmi_profile, u.status, u.created_date, u.created_by, u.last_modified_date, u.last_modified_by, u.last_login_date, u.login_count, u.failed_login_count, u.password_changed_date, LISTAGG(r.role_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.role_name) AS roles, LISTAGG(p.permission_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.permission_name) AS permissions FROM {{usersTable}} u LEFT JOIN {{userRolesTable}} ur ON u.user_id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN {{rolesTable}} r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN {{rolePermissionsTable}} rp ON r.role_id = rp.role_id LEFT JOIN {{permissionsTable}} p ON rp.permission_id = p.permission_id WHERE u.user_id = {{userId}} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.ibmi_profile, u.status, u.created_date, u.created_by, u.last_modified_date, u.last_modified_by, u.last_login_date, u.login_count, u.failed_login_count, u.password_changed_date
